test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Mandatorily, the government announces Minimum Support Prices (MSP) for how many crops?
solution:
The correct answer is __**22**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **22 crops** are currently announced with Minimum Support Prices (MSP) by the government.
 
• The Minimum Support Price is a form of market intervention by the Government of India to insure agricultural producers against any sharp fall in farm prices.
 
• MSP is announced by the Government of India at the beginning of the sowing season for certain crops on the basis of the recommendations of the Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP).
 
• The MSP is aimed at ensuring the farmer a minimum profit for the harvest, if the open market has a lesser price than the cost incurred.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP)** is an attached office of the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India.
 
• The CACP submits separate reports recommending prices for Kharif and Rabi seasons.
 
• MSP is fixed on the recommendations of the CACP, taking into account various factors including the cost of production, changes in input prices, input-output price parity, trends in market prices, demand and supply, and a reasonable margin for farmers.
 
• The crops for which MSP is announced include cereals (paddy, wheat, barley, maize, ragi, jowar, bajra), pulses (gram, arhar/tur, moong, urad, lentil), oilseeds (groundnut, rapeseed and mustard, toria, soyabean, sunflower, safflower, nigerseed, sesamum), and commercial crops (cotton, sugarcane, copra, raw jute).
